title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Founding Full-Stack Engineer

Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.

The opportunity

Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

About us

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

What you'll own

  • The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.

  • Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.

  • Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.

  • Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.

  • Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.

  • The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.

How we build

Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations.

We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve.

We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building.

There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.

What you'll bring

  • Strong Python and backend engineering. You are comfortable designing APIs, services, libraries, and maintainable system boundaries.

  • Full-stack product skills. You can work with TypeScript, React, or similar technologies and build interfaces that make complex systems understandable.

  • Data and integration. You can design data models and pipelines, work with databases, and connect messy external systems to clean internal interfaces.

  • Systems thinking. You think beyond individual services or screens: how data, algorithms, product, and infrastructure fit together.

  • Infrastructure fundamentals. You are comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and operating services.

  • Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.

  • Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.

Bonus: C++ and native Python bindings such as pybind11 or nanobind; data visualization; optimization, scheduling, simulation, or other algorithmic systems; enterprise integrations such as ERP / SAP.

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: shape the product architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.

  • A clear growth path into leading the software engineering team.

  • A real problem worth solving.

  • We equip you with the hardware, compute, and tools you work best with.

  • Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops.

  • Competitive pay + VSOP.

The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)

  1. Send your CV.

  2. Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems.

  3. Meet our CEO and selected investors.

More at home in C++, algorithms, and optimization? Check out our Founding Optimization Engineer role.

description:
Founding Optimization Engineer

Build the algorithmic core of planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape the optimization architecture on a greenfield: custom algorithms, heuristics, OR and simulation, fast C++ with Python on top. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.

The opportunity

Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

About us

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

What you'll own

  • The algorithmic core: Design how planqor.ai represents, propagates and optimizes schedules, resources and constraints, and how it repairs them when disruptions hit.

  • Performance: Make it fast. Profile and optimize the C++ core and expose it cleanly.

  • Evidence: Build the benchmarks, instances and experiments that show what actually works and where it fails.

  • The path to production: Work with our systems engineer to turn algorithms into decisions planners trust.

  • The team: Grow into leading optimization at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.

How we build

Our goal is not to build the most impressive optimization algorithm on paper. It is to build decision systems that remain useful when the real world changes. A strong solution that can be updated, repaired and explained quickly beats closing the last optimality gap on a static model.

So we are neither a solver wrapper nor a research lab. We use whatever works (MIP, CP, heuristics, local search, simulation, learning or something purpose-built) and let the evidence decide.

Generative AI makes this loop dramatically faster. We use it to implement ideas, explore alternatives and evolve algorithms against our benchmarks. But speed only counts if the methodology holds: representative data, adversarial tests, meaningful metrics, rigorous validation.

There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.

What you'll bring

  • Strong modern C++ and performance engineering. You are comfortable building performance-critical algorithms, profiling them, choosing appropriate data structures, and reasoning about runtime, memory, and scalability.

  • Real experience solving optimization problems. This may come from Operations Research, combinatorial optimization, scheduling, MIP/CP, heuristics, local search, simulation, optimization under uncertainty, or related fields. You do not need to be an expert in all of them. Big plus for Sequential Decision Analytics.

  • Systems thinking. You think beyond individual models and algorithms: how state is represented, how changes propagate, how components interact, and how the complete decision system behaves under real-world disruptions.

  • Python for experimentation and data analysis. You can build benchmark pipelines, analyze data, visualize results, and quickly investigate why an approach succeeds or fails.

  • Empirical engineering judgment. You design experiments, challenge assumptions, measure performance, and abandon approaches when the evidence says they are wrong.

  • Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.

  • Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.

title: Offensive Security Engineer
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Offensive security

The internal offensive security team is responsible for the penetration testing program, red team engagements, and offensive research aimed at uncovering sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius Cloud stack.

The Role

We're hiring an Offensive Security Engineer to join us at Nebius. You'll design and execute adversarial simulation across our cloud platform - attacking the same infrastructure our customers depend on - and translate findings into measurable security improvements.

This is a hands-on engineering role within Product Security Team. You will be part of an internal red team, establish a penetration testing program, and conduct research to uncover sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius tech stack.

What you’ll do

  • Validate and extend early-stage Secure SDLC threat models via continuous penetration testing, assessing threat severity and mitigation status while challenging assumptions made during threat modeling and system development. Automate routine validations to keep pace with increasing feature flow, reserving manual analysis for genuinely complex cases.
  • Plan and execute full-scoped red team engagements against Nebius cloud platform - including compute, storage, inference, networking, orchestration layers, and internal tooling. Identify threats, which are able to impact an organization's operations. Work closely with Detection & Response and other security engineering teams to run purple team exercises, validate detection coverage, and close gaps collaboratively.
  • Research novel attacks against GPU infrastructure (e.g., closed-source firmware and vendor driver binaries, device passthrough exploits, SR-IOV/IOMMU misconfigurations, RDMA/InfiniBand fabric attacks, etc.), the inference stack (e.g., vLLM, TRT-LLM), and AI platform managed services (e.g., managed Slurm). Assess tenant-isolation boundaries and how they can be broken at the low-level stack
  • Conduct targeted assessments of new products and infrastructure changes before they ship.
  • Deliver clear, actionable reports for both technical audiences and leadership - with prioritized findings and remediation guidance.
  • Establish red team processes, tooling, and a methodology that scales as the platform grows.

What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years in offensive security - penetration testing, red teaming, or adversary simulation
  • Deep experience attacking cloud-native environments: Kubernetes privilege escalation, cloud IAM abuse, virtualization and container escapes.
  • Strong fundamentals across the attack lifecycle: initial access, persistence, lateral movement, data exfiltration.
  • Proficiency developing custom tooling and post-exploitation capabilities (Python, Go, or similar).
  • Experience running purple team exercises and working constructively with blue teams.
  • Ability to write clear, senior-level reports with business-contextualized risk (not just raw findings) that engineers can easily use.

Nice to have

  • Experience attacking ML infrastructure, model serving pipelines, or GPU clusters.
  • Reverse engineering and exploits development experience
  • Application security experience
  • Familiarity with eBPF bypass techniques or kernel-level exploitation.
  • Background in vulnerability research or CVE discovery.
  • Experience with cloud provider internals (hypervisor/networking layers).
  • Presenting your security research at conferences like BlackHat/DefCon, etc.

Why this role at Nebius

  • Attack surface that's genuinely novel - GPU clusters, AI platforms, multi-tenant cloud at scale.
  • Work alongside world-class engineers on infrastructure that powers frontier AI.
  • Competitive compensation with equity upside in a Nasdaq-listed, high-growth company.
  • Flexible, remote-first culture

Hiring process

  • Recruiter's chat (30mins)
  • Live-coding interview (60mins) to asses basic coding skills
  • Security interview (60mins) to asses domain expertise
  • Security System Design interview (90mins) to assess practical experience
  • (Optional) Technical deep dive (90mins) to present a complex and impact project.
  • Final interview to close the hiring process (45mins)

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Stagiair(e) Backend AI Developer
description:
24-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | hybride | softwareontwikkeling & AI | € 600,– obv 1 fte | wo bachelor of master

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Wil jij bouwen aan slimme applicaties en AI-oplossingen die écht gebruikt worden? Bij Berenschot krijg je de kans om jouw technische kennis in te zetten voor innovatieve en maatschappelijke projecten. Als stagiair(e) binnen team Digital & Data  werk je aan moderne applicaties, Python-backends en agentic AI-oplossingen die organisaties helpen om intelligenter en efficiënter te werken. Je draait direct mee in ons ontwikkelteam en krijgt veel ruimte om initiatief te nemen, nieuwe technologieën te verkennen en jezelf snel te ontwikkelen. Werk jij graag hands-on aan echte oplossingen en ben je niet bang om nieuwe dingen te leren? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou.

Dit ga je doen

Bij Berenschot ontwikkelen we digitale producten voor uiteenlopende opdrachtgevers. Denk aan interne platforms, AI-gedreven workflows, dashboards, API-koppelingen en generatieve-AI-oplossingen voor publieke en maatschappelijke organisaties. Als stagiair(e) help je mee met het ontwikkelen van schaalbare backend-oplossingen en AI-functionaliteiten in onze Azure-cloudomgeving. Je werkt met ervaren collega’s in een Agile/DevOps-werkwijze en zorgt er samen met frontend developers voor dat applicaties en gebruikerservaringen naadloos op elkaar aansluiten.

Dit zijn (onder andere) je taken:

  • Backendservices en API’s ontwikkelen in Python met FastAPI.

  • Werken aan schaalbare applicaties en AI-systemen die zelfstandig tools kunnen gebruiken, informatie ophalen en workflows uitvoeren (agentic).

  • Bouwen aan cloudoplossingen binnen Azure.

  • Nieuwe ideeën snel omzetten naar werkende prototypes en toepassingen.

  • (Online) databronnen ontsluiten en koppelen om te komen tot bruikbare informatie.

Dit zijn voorbeelden van de toepassingen die je helpt bouwen of beheren:

  • Tooling voor datagedreven analyses die organisaties inzicht geven in hun ontwikkel- en groeipotentieel.  

  • Een AI-chatbot die collega’s en klanten helpt om snel antwoorden te vinden op vragen over processen, kennis en documenten.

  • Een slimme offertetool die automatisch offertes opstelt, analyseert en beoordeelt.

Quote

"Bij Berenschot krijg je echt de ruimte om te leren, te experimenteren en te groeien. Je werkt direct mee aan AI-systemen die consultants dagelijks gebruiken en leert daarbij van ervaren engineers." – Stagiair bij Berenschot.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Team Digital & Data bestaat uit een groep nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste adviseurs en specialisten. De groep telt ongeveer 25 collega’s: data scientists, data-analisten en ontwikkelaars die met digitale tools adviesopdrachten ondersteunen. De opdrachten variëren van een aanvraagplatform voor zorginstellingen tot een tarievenanalyse voor de kinderopvang. Het team staat bekend om zijn informele en collegiale werksfeer waarin veel ruimte is voor nieuwe ideeën en eigen inbreng. Samenwerking en kennisdeling staan centraal in deze dynamische omgeving.


Dit neem je mee

We zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste en leergierige stagiair(e):

  • Je volgt een wo bachelor of master in een technische richting.

  • Je hebt ervaring met Python. Heb je een GitHub-profiel link of portfolio? Dan zien we die graag terug in je sollicitatie.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen van REST APIs, bij voorkeur met FastAPI.

  • Je hebt basiskennis van asynchronous programming en good software design.

  • Je hebt interesse in AI, generatieve AI en agentic workflows (bijvoorbeeld. met OpenAI en LangChain); ervaring hiermee is een pre.

  • Je hebt interesse in cloudtechnologieën, met name Azure; ervaring hiermee is een pre.

  • Je beschiktover een uitstekend probleemoplossend vermogen en een nieuwsgierige, leergierige houding.

  • Je hebt heldere communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve instelling.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke commerciële omgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners. Dit geeft ons veel ruimte en vrijheid om ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. De cultuur is informeel, met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap en initiatief.

Dit is wat we jou bieden:

  • Een parttime of fulltime stageplek van 4 tot 6 maanden.

  • Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,– per maand (op fulltime basis).

  • Een laptop.

  • Flexibele werkmogelijkheden, thuiswerken is mogelijk.

  • Regelmatige feedback- en check-inmomenten met je stagebegeleider.

  • Een platte organisatie waarin je écht iets kunt betekenen.

  • Een gezellig team dat werk en plezier goed weet te combineren.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het Stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken.

Solliciteer meteen

Spreekt deze stage je aan? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Oumnia Makrani via WhatsApp (06 13 33 87 70) of per e-mail () voor informatie over de procedure. Oumnia is op vrijdag bereikbaar. Heb je een dringende vraag? Mail dan naar .

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over deze vacature? Collega Job Heuvelmans beantwoordt al jouw vragen met plezier via Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve uitkomst nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Sluit dat goed aan? Dan krijg je snel een concreet aanbod en verwelkomen we je graag in ons team als nieuwe Berenschotter!

title: Mobile Developer - AI Finance Agent
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Sweden. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Sweden.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Network Security Engineer to join our Network team. This role combines deep expertise in network engineering and cybersecurity. You will help implement end-to-end network security architectures for enterprise and data center backbone/fabric environments, work with network architects and the management team to guide these designs through review and approval with the Security team, and operate and maintain the implemented solutions day-to-day.
You are expected to be hands-on with leading firewall platforms (Palo Alto, Check Point, etc.), understand complex routing and switching designs, and be comfortable implementing and troubleshooting these networks.

Responsibilities

  • Implement and maintain Zero Trust-aligned security architectures for both enterprise and data center networks.
  • Configure Layer 3/4 & Multi-VRF Segmentation, Security Policies, Secure Remote access.
  • Implement and test large hyper scale DC Security solutions : IPS/NDR solutions , AntiDDOS solutions.
  • Integrate NGFW platforms with modern identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID and Okta, maintain NGFW management, automation, and logging capabilities required by the Security team.
  • Implement and maintain Security Capabilities, including Layer 7 application inspection, IPS, user identification, ZTNA, and SASE integrations.
  • Integrate and operate monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Grafana, and Akvorado.
  • Regularly perform security hardening, vulnerability management, and patching and upgrades on network and infrastructure devices, and verify the effectiveness of these procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in networking and security protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP(S), DNS, TLS, IPsec, Routing protocols)
  • Experience and Knowledge of Backbone & Datacenter technologies (EVPN, L3VPN MPLS, MPBGP, L2VPN..)
  • Hands-on experience with next-generation firewalls (Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, or similar).
  • Experience with automation using Python, Go, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in Unix/Linux and experience with major network vendors (Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, etc.).
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting NGFW capabilities and integrations, including IPS, User-ID, Microsoft Entra ID, and ZTNA.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Good knowledge of IPv6.
  • Experience with automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, NetBox, SaltStack, etc.).
  • Experience with large-scale, highly available distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of Zero Trust principles and micro-segmentation approaches.
  • Relevant certifications (CCNP/CCIE, PCNSE, NSE 4/7) and professional working proficiency in English.
  • Familiarity with commercial or open-source monitoring, logging, and security analytics solutions such as Splunk; EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike; and centralized NGFW management platforms such as Panorama, Strata Cloud Manager, and FortiManager.
  • Bonus: Exposure to DevSecOps practices (SAST/DAST), CSPM/CWPP platforms such as Wiz, EDR, offensive security (OSCP/CPTS, red teaming), or security frameworks, standards, and regulations such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and GDPR.

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Software Developer - Fokus Secure Software Development (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Sicherheit ist für uns bei isento ein fester Bestandteil exzellenter Software-Architektur: Wir entwickeln geschäftskritische Web- und Cloudanwendungen, die im Alltag zuverlässig funktionieren und von Grund auf geschützt sind.

Als Software Developer mit Fokus Secure Software Development entwickelst Du in unseren Projekten aktiv mit Java, Spring Boot, Python oder Angular. Gleichzeitig übernimmst Du eine tragende Rolle für den internen Wissensaufbau: Du beschäftigst Dich mit modernen Sicherheitsaspekten, teilst Best Practices mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen und wirkst an zukunftsweisenden Themen wie der sicheren Entwicklung und dem Schutz von KI-Systemen und LLMs mit.

Dich erwarten eingespielte isento-Teams, flache Hierarchien und der Freiraum, eigene Ideen einzubringen und das Thema Software-Sicherheit im gesamten Unternehmen aktiv mitzugestalten.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben bei isento

  • Du konzipierst und entwickelst im Team moderne und sichere Softwarelösungen im Cloud- und Webumfeld auf Basis von Java, Spring Boot und Angular
  • Verständlicher Code, automatisierte Tests, gegenseitige Code Reviews und Pair Programming gehören dabei genauso zu Deinem Alltag wie das gemeinsame Finden der besten technischen Lösung
  • In Deinem Team bist Du Ansprechpartner für sichere Softwarelösungen und unterstützt auch andere Teams bei Fragen rund um Secure Coding und Sicherheitsanalysen
  • Du bringst Dein Know-how aktiv bei isento ein: Du gestaltest interne Tech-Sessions, sensibilisierst für aktuelle Bedrohungen und etablierst Best Practices im AlltagDu beschäftigst Dich mit modernen Trends rund um Application Security, DevSecOps sowie dem sicheren und datenschutzkonformen Einsatz von KI-Systemen

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit

  • Mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Java sowie ein gutes Verständnis für moderne Web-Architekturen
  • Echte Begeisterung für Secure Coding und DevSecOps
  • Freude daran, Wissen im Team weiterzugeben, Kolleginnen und Kollegen für Sicherheitsthemen zu begeistern und gemeinsam voneinander zu lernen
  • Hilfreich sind Kenntnisse in Spring Boot, Angular, Python, relationalen Datenbanken, Docker, Cloud-Technologien und Generativer KI
  • Sichere Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B2) sowie gutes Englisch für die erfolgreiche Abstimmung im Team und mit Kunden

Benefits

Deine Benefits bei isento

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten und Möglichkeiten zu Workation und Sabbaticals für eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance
  • Eingespielte isento-Teams mit verlässlichem Rückhalt in allen Kundenprojekten: Unsere Projekte werden überwiegend von unseren eigenen Teams umgesetzt. Du arbeitest mit Deinen isento-Kolleginnen und -Kollegen zusammen und hast gleichzeitig direkten Kontakt zu unseren Kunden
  • Volle Unterstützung für Deine persönliche Weiterbildung: Konferenzen und Zertifizierungen, die zu Dir passen (z. B. im Bereich DevSecOps oder Cloud-Architektur)
  • Mitarbeiterangebote und Zuschüsse zum JobRad-Leasing, zum ÖPNV und zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
  • Eine offene Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen internen Open-Space-Events (Duke Days), Teamevents und Grillabenden auf unserer Dachterrasse in Nürnberg
  • Ein ausgezeichneter Top-Arbeitgeber mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echtem Miteinander

Klingt gut? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams.

title: Stage - Développeur(euse) IA Générative (H/F/X) - Janvier 2027
description:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

  • Rejoignez notre équipe dynamique et innovante spécialisée dans le développement d'applications basées sur l'intelligence artificielle générative (GenAI). Nous travaillons sur des projets à forte valeur ajoutée en intégrant des technologies de pointe pour créer des solutions intelligentes dans des domaines variés (logistique, production, finance, marketing…)

  • En tant que stagiaire développeur au sein de l'équipe GenAI, vous participerez activement à la conception, au développement et à l'optimisation d'applications basées sur l'IA générative. Sous la supervision de nos experts, vous contribuerez à toutes les phases du cycle de développement de logiciels, de l’analyse des besoins à la livraison des solutions, tout en collaborant avec des data scientists, des ingénieurs et des spécialistes en IA.


    • 🎯 MISSIONS

  • Développer et maintenir des modules logiciels utilisant des modèles de génération d’IA (GPT, diffusion, etc.).

  • Participer à l’optimisation de l’utilisation d’IA générative en termes de performance et d’efficacité.

  • Collaborer avec l'équipe pour intégrer l'IA générative dans des applications web, mobiles ou systèmes d’entreprise.

  • Effectuer des tests et assurer la validation des modèles et des fonctionnalités développées.

  • Contribuer à la documentation technique et aux rapports de performance.


    • 👉 PRÉ REQUIS

  • Vous êtes actuellement en formation Bac+4/5 en informatique ou ingénierie (école d’ingénieur, université).

  • Vous avez des compétences en programmation (Python, JavaScript, C#...) et un intérêt prononcé pour les technologies IA/ML.

  • Vous êtes curieux, rigoureux, et aimez le travail en équipe.

  • Vous avez un bon niveau d’anglais technique (lu/écrit).


    • 👉 LE PETIT PLUS

  • La connaissance des bases de données vectorielles et des algorithmes de calcul de distance

  • La connaissance d’orchestrateur tels que Long Chain ou Semantic kernel


    • ❓ EN SAVOIR PLUS SUR L'ÉQUIPE

  • Une première expérience de construction d'agents LLM : tool calling, boucles agentiques, frameworks comme LangGraph, PydanticAI, OpenAI Agents SDK ou Claude Agent SDK

  • La connaissance du Model Context Protocol (MCP) ou du format Agent Skills pour connecter des agents à des outils et à des données

  • Une sensibilité à l'évaluation des systèmes à base de LLM : jeux de tests, LLM-as-a-judge, observabilité et traces (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry…)

  • Des notions de RAG : embeddings, recherche hybride, reranking, bases vectorielles (pgvector, Qdrant…)

  • Une curiosité pour les modèles open-weight et leur adaptation : fine-tuning (LoRA, TRL, Unsloth), serving (vLLM)

  • Une pratique régulière des assistants de code (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex…), avec un regard critique sur ce qu'ils produisent

  • Un projet perso, une contribution open source ou un repo GitHub à nous montrer


    • ✅ AVANTAGES
  • 👉Bureau flexible avec au minimum 3 jours sur place et jusqu'à 2 jours à domicile
  • 👉Plate-forme d'apprentissage des langues en ligne
  • 👉Comité d’entreprise CE et ses nombreux avantages
  • 👉Accès à une restauration d'entreprise et cantine connecté
  • 👉Accès à la Salle de sport
  • 👉Congés selon la durée du contrat

title: NOC Engineer Level 2
description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

About the role

As a Level 2 NOC Engineer, you’ll go beyond day-to-day monitoring to handle escalations that require deeper technical expertise. This role blends advanced troubleshooting, provisioning process exposure, and OSS/automation skills to strengthen service reliability. You will support Level 1 engineers, collaborate with engineering teams, and contribute to process and tool improvements that make our NOC smarter and more resilient

What you'll do:

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for the NOC Level 1 team for complex or unresolved issues.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting and service restoration activities across core network and service platforms.
  • Operate the telco platform to cover the business processes of eSIM manufacturing, eSIM stock management, tariff configuration, and services provisioning in the telecom network.
  • Developing automation and operational scripts, metrics, alarms, and healthcheck routines. (e.g., scripting, tool integration, dashboard improvements).
  • Collaborate with engineering, development, and third-party vendors to implement long-term solutions and preventative measures.
  • Document solutions, update run-books, and enrich the NOC knowledge base.
  • Provide technical guidance to Level 1 engineers.
  • Participate in on-call rotation for high-priority incidents outside standard hours.
  • Assist in identifying and analyzing recurring issues, supporting Root Cause Analysis and long-term improvements.

What you'll bring:

  • Proven experience as a NOC Engineer or in a similar role, with a strong track record of resolving complex technical issues.
  • Solid understanding of telecom and network principles, including mobile core concepts and eSIM technology.
  • Familiarity with API integrations and monitoring tools.
  • Proficiency in scripting/automation (e.g., Python, Bash) to streamline NOC activities.
  • Ability to interpret technical logs and system outputs.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively under pressure.
  • Good communication skills for coordination with teams and external partners.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with OSS/BSS platforms and monitoring solutions (Prometheus, Grafana, etc.).
  • Exposure to provisioning workflows
  • Familiarity with TM Forum frameworks (eTOM/TAM) and ITSM frameworks (ITIL).
  • Cloud platform knowledge (AWS).
  • Networking or cloud certifications.
  • Deep familiarity with eSIM and GSMA technologies.
  • Experience with Mobile Core Network Monitoring and troubleshooting.

Compensation

At Airalo, we believe in roaming-free recruitment. Just as we provide clear connectivity for travelers, we provide clear salary ranges for our candidates. 🌍 This role is remote and open to candidates across our supported locations in Europe. The range below reflects the full salary range for this role across the countries where it's available:

📍 UK: £53,200 – £79,800
📍 Spain: €48,000 – €72,000
📍 Western & Northern Europe: €53,600 – €97,200
📍 Southern Europe: €40,000 – €96,000
📍 Central Europe: €42,800 – €73,300
📍 South-Eastern Europe: €42,600 – €64,600

Your Home Destination 🛫
At Airalo, we use localized market data, so your compensation band depends on where you’re based. You can learn more about our compensation philosophy in our public handbook.

Most of our hires come in within the first half of the band, which leaves you room to grow, and you’ll see exactly what that looks like from day one. In exceptional cases, where a candidate’s skills and experience clearly exceed the role’s requirements, we’re happy to discuss going higher.
We’ll walk through your range together on your first call with our Talent team, so we’re all aligned for takeoff! 🎒✨

Additional Information

Why People Join Us

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

On-Call

Participating in our on-call rotation is a core expectation of this role. It's essential for maintaining 24/7 service reliability across our global operations, ensuring our systems remain resilient and our customers experience uninterrupted service, regardless of time zone or geography.

  • Paid Rotation: We offer standby fees + overtime pay.
  • Delayed Start: No on-call duties for your first 6 months.
  • Rest & Recovery: Guaranteed rest periods and flexible hours following night incidents.
  • Shared Load: Rotations are split (Weekdays vs. Weekends) to minimize fatigue.

Please refer to the On-Call Policy in the Airalo Handbook for full details: https://airalo-public.notion.site/our-approach-to-engineering-on-call-policy

Before You Hit Apply

By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy

We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. Airalo is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity, equity & inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.

title: Back-end Engineer
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer within our Commodities tribe, you will lead the end-to-end integration of US inland waterway barge data into Kpler’s global cargo intelligence platform. Operating under a "you build it, you run it" philosophy, you will design robust ingestion paths, stream real-time data using Kafka, and connect barge movement models directly to our customer-facing surfaces. This role carries genuine design authority, empowering you to solve complex entity resolution problems while mentoring peers and elevating technical craft across our crews.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end integration architecture: Drive the full engineering lifecycle—from external feed ingestion and domain modeling to streaming, entity resolution, and UI distribution.

  • Design robust ingestion & entity-resolution systems: Map incoming barge data onto Kpler reference data (vessels, zones, installations, products) using existing Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL matching patterns.

  • Build scalable Kafka streaming pipelines: Construct event-driven contracts, schemas (Avro), deduplication mechanisms, and dead-letter queue replays with Python and Scala.

  • Deliver data across customer surfaces: Surface integrated barge data cleanly across Elasticsearch read models, external APIs, data warehouse feeds, and the Kpler Terminal (TypeScript/Vue).

  • Champion production quality & observability: Maintain full operational ownership of your services, setting SLOs, participating in on-call rotations, and driving post-incident improvements.

  • Ensure data integrity & analyst alignment: Validate external feeds and integrate human-in-the-loop analyst workflows so corrections seamlessly apply to barge movements.

  • Mentor and elevate engineering craft: Guide and mentor crew members, document architectural designs, and actively contribute to decomposing legacy estates into event-driven services.


    • Experience & Background
    What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • Production data engineering experience: ~5+ years of experience designing, operating, and maintaining data-intensive production systems with full ownership.

  • Advanced Python & SQL expertise: Proven ability to build clean, well-bounded services within large, complex, and evolving codebases.

  • Event-driven streaming proficiency: Hands-on experience with Kafka streaming in production, including schema management (Avro/Schema Registry), deduplication, and replay patterns.

  • Third-party integration & entity resolution: Demonstrated background integrating external data feeds, managing schema mapping, and building data quality monitoring frameworks.

  • Operational mindset: Direct experience managing production observability, writing documentation, and resolving incidents in a distributed system environment.

    • Nice-to-haves

  • Functional programming & Scala: Experience or familiarity with Scala (Kafka Streams) or a track record of rapidly mastering new languages.

  • Geospatial & domain knowledge: Familiarity with geospatial data tools (PostGIS) or exposure to maritime, logistics, or commodities domains.

  • Modern data stack exposure: Experience with Elasticsearch, Airflow, Snowflake/lakehouse table formats, Kubernetes, and GitOps deployments.

  • UI/Frontend collaboration: Working knowledge of TypeScript or Vue to collaborate on user-facing terminal features.

title: Database Engineer (Stateful Services)
description:
Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications.

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI and human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.
As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Database Engineer (Stateful Services) to help build and operate the infrastructure foundation behind the platform.
This is a unique opportunity to work on an infrastructure environment combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while helping us build the reliability and operational maturity required to support 3x growth.
You will report to the newly forming Stateful Services Lead and work closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure teams to improve the reliability, scalability and evolution of our stateful systems.

Your mission

Your goal is to build, operate and improve Diabolocom’s stateful services, with a strong focus on databases and data stores.
You will help ensure that our databases and stateful systems remain highly available, reliable and performant, while evolving our infrastructure so that maintenance, upgrades and scaling can be performed safely and with minimal to no downtime.
Working closely with the Stateful Services Lead, you will take ownership of specific technical projects and contribute to the evolution of our stateful infrastructure.

You will:

  • Operate and maintain our stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ and Kafka/Redpanda.
  • Contribute to the design, evolution and scaling of our database infrastructure, with 50+ PostgreSQL clusters and increasingly complex data workloads.
  • Work on projects aimed at making database maintenance, upgrades and migrations safer and less disruptive to our services.
  • Improve high availability, replication, failover, backup/restore and disaster recovery across our stateful systems.
  • Contribute to rebuilding our PostgreSQL clusters to support automatic failover between data centers and reduce the impact of maintenance operations.
  • Help improving our queueing infrastructure, including projects such as quorum-based RabbitMQ.
  • Help building and maintaining stable Redis infrastructure and improve the reliability of our stateful services.
  • Investigate and solve complex performance, scalability and reliability issues across databases and distributed systems.
  • Work closely with development teams to understand their needs, support their use of databases and help them build reliable solutions.
  • Collaborate with SRE, networking and infrastructure teams to ensure that our stateful services operate reliably within our broader infrastructure.
  • Contribute to monitoring, automation and operational practices that make our infrastructure easier and safer to operate.
  • Participate in our on-call and incident management rotation, helping diagnose and resolve production issues when needed.
  • Stay hands-on and close to the technology: you will be expected to understand how our systems work, how they fail and how to improve them.

Who we are looking for

We’re looking for a technically strong and hands-on Database Engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure problems and taking ownership of production systems where reliability really matters.
You have experience operating databases or stateful services in production and understand that running these systems is about much more than simply maintaining them. You know how to troubleshoot them, how they behave under load, how they fail, and how to make them more reliable as they scale.
You’ll work on specific technical projects defined with the Stateful Services Lead, while having the autonomy to investigate problems, propose solutions and contribute to technical decisions.
We care more about your technical depth, curiosity and ability to take ownership than the exact number of years of experience you have.

Must Have

  • Strong hands-on experience as a DBA, Database Engineer, SRE or similar, with solid experience in PostgreSQL.
  • Experience operating and maintaining production databases, including upgrades, migrations, replication, backups, recovery, monitoring and performance troubleshooting.
  • Good understanding of high availability and reliability for stateful systems: failover, redundancy, replication, disaster recovery and minimising downtime during maintenance.
  • Good understanding of distributed systems, including replication, consistency, fault tolerance and the challenges of operating stateful services at scale.
  • Experience working with on-premise infrastructure or a willingness and ability to quickly adapt to an on-premise/bare-metal environment.
  • Good system design skills and the ability to reason about scalability, reliability and performance.
  • Experience collaborating closely with software development teams, understanding their requirements and helping them build reliable solutions around databases and stateful services.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex production issues.
  • Strong hands-on mindset: you enjoy getting into the technical details and solving problems yourself.
  • Comfortable participating in on-call and incident management.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus.

Nice to Have

Experience with some of the following:
  • ClickHouse or another complex database/data platform.
  • Kafka or Redpanda and event-streaming infrastructure.
  • RabbitMQ, particularly quorum-based configurations.
  • Redis and distributed caching.
  • Other database technologies such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MySQL, Cassandra or MongoDB.
  • Advanced Linux systems administration, including processes, storage, networking and troubleshooting.
  • Bare-metal infrastructure and data-center environments.
  • Observability and monitoring of stateful systems.
  • Capacity planning, performance analysis and load testing.
  • Infrastructure automation and configuration management.
  • Incident management, root-cause analysis and post-mortem practices.

About You

  • You take ownership. When you see a reliability or scalability problem, you investigate it and work towards a solution.
  • You are genuinely technical. You like understanding how things work under the hood and are comfortable diving deep when something breaks.
  • You think in systems. You understand that databases don't operate in isolation and enjoy working across infrastructure, networking, SRE and development teams.
  • You care about reliability. You want systems that can be maintained, upgraded and scaled without putting the business at risk.
  • You are pragmatic. You can make sensible technical trade-offs in complex environments.
  • You are curious and self-driven. You learn by doing, investigate unfamiliar technologies and are comfortable figuring things out independently.
  • You enjoy solving complex problems. You like working on systems where there isn't always an obvious answer.
  • You communicate clearly. You can explain technical topics and work effectively with the teams relying on your services.
  • You are comfortable taking responsibility. You don't need to be a manager to have an impact or take the lead on a technical problem.

Why join us

  • Own critical infrastructure: your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of Diabolocom’s platform.
  • Solve complex technical challenges: work with large-scale databases and stateful services, including PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, Redis and RabbitMQ.
  • Work on real infrastructure challenges: help improve PostgreSQL clusters, cross-data-center failover, RabbitMQ and Redis reliability.
  • Stay hands-on: spend your time solving challenging technical problems rather than managing people.
  • Learn and grow: work across databases, distributed systems, messaging and infrastructure in a diverse technical environment.
  • Work across teams: collaborate closely with Engineering, SRE and Infrastructure to build reliable systems at scale.

Recruitment Process

  1. Introductory call with Talent Acquisition (1h)
  2. Interview with Sergey, our CTO (1h)
  3. On-site System Design interview with Sergey (1h)
    Work through a technical case study and explore your system design approach.
  4. Cultural fit interview with the Team (1h)

Logistics

📍 Paris, rue de la Paix, 75002
🏢 Hybrid model: 3 days onsite / 2 days remote
💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)
🍽  Lunch vouchers
🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed

One More Thing

We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already worked in this exact role or with every technology in our stack.
The strongest candidates are often engineers who have built and operated complex infrastructure, taken ownership of production systems and learned new technologies along the way.
If you enjoy solving difficult technical problems, want to work close to the infrastructure and are excited by the challenge of making stateful systems more reliable and scalable — we would love to talk.


At Diabolocom, diversity and inclusion are in our DNA. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to color, language, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national or social origin, opinion disability, age.

As part of our hiring process, please note that any employment offer or service provider offer will be subject to a background check, including verification of your identity, educational credentials, and previous employment history.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

Solutions Consultants, Post-Sales at Ramp partner with Account Management to deepen and expand relationships with existing Ramp customers. title: TYPO3 Developer
description:
TYPO3 Developer
(Mensch)

Andere zählen Schafe. Du zählst TYPO3-Major-Versionen, die du schon migriert hast. Und hast Lust, die Websites großer, internationaler Unternehmen technisch zu verantworten?

Zur Übersicht

Der ultimative TYPO3-Check

Du bist bei uns richtig, wenn du…

  • … bei „Wir brauchen nur ein kleines Feld mehr im Backend“ im Kopf schon TCA, Datenbank-Migration und die drei Fluid-Templates aufklappst, die es wirklich braucht.

  • … für dein wichtigstes Werkzeug hältst. Direkt nach dem Cache-Leeren.

  • … beim Satz „Das ging in TYPO3 v7 aber noch“ freundlich lächelst und den Extension Scanner startest.

  • … sofort merkst, wenn dir die KI eine TypoScript-Lösung aus dem Jahr 2014 andreht. Und sie trotzdem jeden Tag nutzt, weil sie dich schneller macht.

  • … und dein Gewissen dir verbietet, freitags um 16 Uhr ein Major-Update auf Production zu schieben. Auch nicht „nur schnell“.

… dann gilt für uns nur noch eins: composer require netfed/du

Worum geht es?

Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Technik großer Corporate-Websites. Von der Aufwandsschätzung über Konzeption und Neuaufbau bis zu Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates. Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte auf einem sauberen technischen Fundament stehen.

Warum diese Rolle bei uns anders ist?

Wir arbeiten für namhafte Konzerne und große Mittelständler, bei denen die Website ein strategisches Aushängeschild ist. Du baust hier nicht Website Nummer 47 nach Schema F. Du triffst die technischen Entscheidungen und verantwortest die Architektur. Dabei vertrauen wir voll auf deine Erfahrung. Dazu kommen eine eigene, von uns betriebene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung und eine gelebte DevOps-Kultur, die sich am Stand der Technik orientiert.

Und was ist mit KI?

Gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Werkzeug. Du arbeitest mit KI als Sparringspartner: beim Refactoring, beim Testen, beim Dokumentieren, beim schnellen Zweitblick auf eine Migration. Die KI schlägt vor, du entscheidest. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden mit echter TYPO3-Erfahrung, der erkennt, wann ein Vorschlag gut ist und wann er Unsinn ist.

Was sind deine Aufgaben?

  • Du erstellst die technische Konzeption neu aufzubauender TYPO3-Websites.

  • Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Aspekte großer Kundenprojekte: Aufwandsschätzung, Neuaufbau, Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates.

  • Du setzt KI-Tools im Entwickleralltag ein und bringst unseren KI-Einsatz in der Entwicklung weiter voran.

  • Du dokumentierst so, dass andere weiterarbeiten können. Auch dein zukünftiges Ich.

Beratung und Support

  • Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden bei technischen Themen, zum Beispiel bei der Wahl der CMS-Architektur.

  • Du bearbeitest Kunden-Tickets und Support-Anfragen, die unser First-Level-Support nicht direkt lösen kann.

  • Du übersetzt Technik in Kunden-Deutsch und Kundenwünsche in saubere Technik.

Was bringst du mit?

  • 4 bis 8 Jahre Erfahrung mit der Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Websites auf Basis von TYPO3.

  • Du kennst dich mit den umgebenden Tools und Technologien aus, zum Beispiel Composer, JSON, JavaScript und XML.

  • Du beherrschst den Umgang mit SQL-Datenbanken, zum Beispiel MariaDB.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI-Coding-Tools und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht.

  • Du arbeitest gern agil mit Jira, Confluence und GitLab.

Wäre gut,
aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit WordPress.

  • Erfahrung mit Solr oder Elasticsearch.

  • Praxis mit Docker, Kubernetes und DevOps-Methoden.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Werkzeuge: Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Office 365, Docker, Kubernetes

  • Infrastruktur: Eigene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung mit technologischem Freiraum, in der Entwicklung und im Live-Betrieb

  • Starkes Netzwerk: Als Teil der team neusta Gruppe hast du kurze Wege zu über 800 Expert:innen, wenn dein Projekt zusätzliche Spezialpower braucht.

  • Zeitraum: ab sofort

Interesse?

Wir verzichten auf klassische Anschreiben.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und gerne 2 bis 3 kurze Beispiele aus deinen TYPO3-Projekten: TYPO3-Version, Umfang des Projekts, deine Rolle, größte technische Herausforderung.

Und ein Satz dazu, wie du KI beim Entwickeln einsetzt, hilft uns sehr.

Teilst du uns dabei auch deinen Gehaltswunsch und deinen frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin mit? Das wäre prima.

Nutzen Sie den Button auf dieser Seite für Ihre Bewerbung.

Unser Team, deine Vorteile

Wir bei NetFed sind davon überzeugt, dass es ein gutes Arbeitsklima und gegenseitige Wertschätzung benötigt, um produktiv arbeiten zu können. Unsere Erfolgsformel für NetFed-Wachstum heißt deshalb: Wir schaffen gemeinsam mit unseren Mitarbeiter:innen ein optimales Arbeitsumfeld, das Spaß und Leidenschaft bei der Arbeit ermöglicht und gleichzeitig genügend Spielraum für das Privatleben lässt.

Das sind unsere Vorteile:

  • Fort- und Weiterbildung

  • Family Life Balance

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Homeoffice

  • Freiwillige Sozial­leistungen

  • Urban Sports Club

Lust auf mehr? Unser Team stellt sich dir gerne persönlich vor.

description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each memberâs life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries â from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets â including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review â as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity ð

As Corporate Counsel, Commercial, you will be the legal partner behind Carrotâs customer and vendor contracts. Day to day, you will negotiate, draft, and review a high volume of commercial agreements, including master services agreements, service level agreements, professional services agreements, and NDAs. You will partner closely with Sales and other business teams to resolve redlines and customer questions quickly, manage most matters from start to finish, and escalate high-risk issues when the moment calls for it.

About You â¨

title: Compliance Officer/MLRO
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the worldâs leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 â connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Â 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Â 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Purpose

Lead the establishment and ongoing oversight of the Pakistan entityâs independent Compliance function and Anti-Money Laundering, Counter-Terrorist Financing and Counter-Proliferation Financing (AML/CFT/CPF) framework.
During the pre-licensing phase, the role holder will lead Compliance-owned licensing deliverables, develop the local control framework and assess operational readiness. Following licensing, the role holder will discharge the entityâs CO/MLRO responsibilities, advise the Board and senior management, and maintain effective engagement with PVARA, the Financial Monitoring Unit (FMU) and other relevant authorities.
The role combines CO and MLRO responsibilities, subject to applicable regulatory requirements and any required regulatory acceptance or approval. The suitability of the combined arrangement will be reviewed periodically, considering independence, conflicts, capacity, resources and the entityâs nature, scale and complexity.
Â 

Key Responsibilities

  1. Licensing and Operational Readiness
  • Lead Compliance-owned components of the PVARA licensing application and coordinate relevant inputs from Legal, Business, Risk, Finance, Operations and Technology.
  • Develop and maintain a regulatory obligations register, licensing deliverables tracker and local implementation roadmap.
  • Assess gaps between group policies, systems and controls and applicable Pakistan requirements; oversee localisation and track remediation.
  • Establish local Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF policies, governance arrangements, escalation procedures and regulatory reporting processes.
  • Define local control requirements for customer onboarding, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, Travel Rule compliance and suspicious transaction reporting.
  • Assess the suitability and readiness of local, group-provided and outsourced controls, including relevant pre-launch testing.
  • Provide a documented Compliance and AML readiness assessment to the appropriate governance forum, escalating unresolved material gaps before launch.
Â 
  1. Compliance Oversight
  • Establish, administer and maintain a documented, risk-based Compliance Management System (CMS) proportionate to the entityâs activities and risk profile.
  • Advise the Board, relevant committees and senior management on applicable legal and regulatory requirements, licence conditions and regulatory developments.
  • Develop and execute a risk-based Compliance Monitoring and Testing Plan; document findings, agree remediation ownership and deadlines with accountable functions, independently validate closure, and escalate overdue or inadequate remediation.
  • Oversee compliance with applicable conduct, customer protection, complaints-handling, client-asset and market-integrity requirements, according to the entityâs licensed activities.
  • Review proposed products, services and material business changes from a local compliance perspective, identifying requirements, restrictions and necessary controls.
  • Ensure material non-compliance is investigated, promptly escalated and remediated, and notified to PVARA where required.
  • Maintain regulatory submission and commitment trackers, overseeing timely and accurate Compliance-owned responses and escalating dependency risks.
  • Act as the primary Compliance liaison with PVARA for supervisory engagement, inspections and information requests.
  • Develop and oversee Compliance training for employees, senior management and relevant key individuals.
Â 
  1. AML/CFT/CPF and Financial Crime
  • Establish, implement and maintain the entityâs AML/CFT/CPF framework, aligned with applicable Pakistan legislation, regulatory requirements and relevant directions or guidance.
  • Lead the enterprise-wide financial crime risk assessment and oversee risk-based mitigation measures.
  • Oversee customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, customer risk assessment, enhanced due diligence and ongoing monitoring.
  • Oversee transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and targeted financial sanctions controls, including escalation and action on relevant alerts.
  • Oversee virtual asset-specific controls, including blockchain analytics, risks associated with unhosted wallets and Travel Rule compliance where applicable.
  • Receive and assess internal suspicious activity referrals, determine whether external reporting is required, and submit suspicious transaction reports to the FMU within applicable deadlines.
  • Exercise independent judgement on suspicious transaction reporting without requiring business approval, while maintaining confidentiality and preventing tipping-off.
  • Manage the entityâs FMU/goAML registration, access arrangements and reporting processes, as applicable.
  • Ensure required customer, transaction and investigation records are retained for applicable periods and remain accessible and retrievable.
  • Liaise with the FMU and other competent authorities on financial crime matters and oversee relevant information requests.
  • Oversee AML/CFT/CPF training and awareness, tailored to employeesâ responsibilities and exposure to risk.
Â 
  1. Governance, Reporting and Control Assurance
  • Provide periodic reports to the Board or designated committee on Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF effectiveness, material risks, incidents, findings and remediation progress.
  • Escalate urgent or material matters promptly rather than waiting for scheduled reporting.
  • Attend relevant Board and committee meetings and provide independent advice and challenge.
  • Assess and oversee group-provided and outsourced Compliance/AML services, including local regulatory suitability, service standards, data access, management information and escalation arrangements.
  • Oversee delegated Compliance and AML/CFT/CPF activities and remain accountable for discharging the CO/MLRO responsibilities, without displacing the responsibilities of the entity, Board, senior management or operational control owners.
  • Coordinate with Risk and Internal Audit, while preserving the distinction between Compliance oversight and independent audit assurance.
  • Support periodic review of the role holderâs continuing fitness, propriety and suitability, including the required review of the MLRO appointment.
  • Maintain effective handover and suitably qualified cover arrangements for absences, consistent with applicable regulatory requirements.
Â 

Qualifications and Experience

Essential
  • A degree in law, finance, business or a related discipline, or an equivalent relevant professional qualification.
  • At least eight yearsâ relevant Compliance and/or AML/CFT experience in financial services, including at least three years in a senior Compliance, MLRO or equivalent leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of Pakistanâs financial regulatory and AML/CFT framework, including the Virtual Assets Act, applicable PVARA regulations, the Anti-Money Laundering Act and FMU reporting requirements.
  • Demonstrable understanding of virtual asset business models and their financial crime, conduct and operational risks.
  • Practical experience with customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, investigations and suspicious transaction reporting.
  • Experience developing risk assessments, policies, monitoring programmes and Board-level reporting.
  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements into workable business, operational and technology controls.
  • Be resident in Pakistan by the date of the formal CO/MLRO appointment and maintain residency as required under applicable regulations.
  • Fluency in English and Urdu.
Â 
Desirable
  • Professional certification such as CAMS, an ICA qualification or an equivalent Compliance/AML credential.
  • Experience in virtual assets, exchanges, fintech or digital financial services.
  • Experience supporting a regulatory licence application or establishing a local Compliance function.
  • Experience engaging with PVARA, FMU, SECP, SBP or other relevant Pakistani authorities.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools and Travel Rule solutions.
  • Experience overseeing centralised group services and outsourced control arrangements.
Â 
Key Competencies
  • Independence, integrity and sound judgement.
  • Confidence to challenge senior management constructively.
  • Clear communication with regulators, the Board and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective prioritisation in a developing regulatory environment.
  • Ability to build a local control framework while working within a global organisation.
Â 
Authority and Independence
  • Direct access to the local Board or designated committee, including the ability to escalate without prior management clearance.
  • Timely and unrestricted access to relevant records, systems, personnel and management information necessary to discharge the role, subject to applicable confidentiality and data-handling requirements.
  • Adequate resources and suitably qualified support proportionate to the entityâs activities and risk profile.
  • No client-facing, sales or other responsibilities that compromise independence, create material conflicts or impair CO/MLRO duties.
  • Remuneration arrangements that do not link the role holderâs performance to sales or revenue targets.
  • Group reporting arrangements that do not restrict local regulatory accountability, Board access or independent MLRO decision-making.
  • Board oversight of appointment, replacement and removal, with regulatory approvals or notifications completed as applicable.
Â 
Regulatory Appointment Conditions
The role holder must satisfy applicable fitness and propriety, residency, employment, competence and regulatory appointment requirements at appointment and on an ongoing basis. Any required PVARA approval, acceptance or notification must be completed in accordance with the applicable framework.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.Â 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
